title: MAI-Image-2.7 and MAI-Image-2.7-Flash now available on AI Gateway
summary_en: Microsoft’s MAI-Image-2.7 and MAI-Image-2.7-Flash are now available in public preview on AI Gateway . Both increase the maximum output size to 2048 x 2048 pixels and add transparent backgrounds for generated and edited images. Generate images from text or edit existing images with one AI Gateway API key, without a Microsoft account. Both models support photorealistic images, text rendering, and targeted edits to products, portraits, and layouts. Use up to five reference images to guide edits or combine subjects.
